issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: The problem statement (UML and description) declares Rideable.messageOnRide() as a no-argument method returning String, and the template Main calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments. The solution repository, however, declares Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and the implementing classes Pig and Seal implement messageOnRide(String). This mismatch (no-arg vs one-arg) will cause compilation/signature incompatibilities for students following the problem/template and prevents straightforward integration or testing against the provided template/Main usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across all artifacts. Recommended: change the solution to match the problem/template by declaring Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters and update Pig and Seal to implement public String messageOnRide() returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]". Alternatively, if an equipment parameter is intended pedagogically, update the problem statement (UML and text) and the template/Main usage to declare and call messageOnRide(String equipment) so every artifact uses the same signature.
